name: LIFE THE SIMULATOR PHONE
source: Your girlfriend is abroad. The notifications won’t stop. Between text messages, social media, dates, money transfers, and off-screen drama, you discover what’s unfolding behind your back desire, lies, control, humiliation.
translation: 你的女友身在国外，手机通知却一刻不停地弹出。在短信、社交媒体、约会记录、转账账单与屏幕之外的暗流涌动之间，你一步步窥见了背着你悄然上演的一切——欲望、谎言、操控与羞辱。
